claim.purpose: Route bounded mixed Runtime v3 and CSM changes through independent focused validation

initial.title: [v0.91.7][tooling][CI] Keep mixed Runtime v3 and CSM validation out of Runtime v2 coverage
initial.goal: Prove mixed Runtime v3 and CSM changes without executing unrelated Runtime v2 coverage.
initial.required_outcome: A narrowly recognized mixed-crate family runs focused tests and composed coverage in each owning crate.
authority_boundary: Issue #5494 owns the Runtime v3 and CSM implementation
initial.task_boundary: Add one bounded mixed Runtime v3 and CSM validation route without weakening other fail-closed classifications.
deliverables: Mixed Runtime v3 and CSM source classifier
Independent focused test execution for both crates
Regression contracts preserving unrelated mixed-crate fail-closed behavior
acceptance_criteria: AC1: The #5504 source shape selects bounded PR-fast validation
AC2: Focused tests execute in both owning crates
AC3: Focused coverage composes both crate summaries
AC4: Runtime v2 tests are not selected
AC5: Unrelated or unmapped mixed-crate changes still fail closed
dependencies: Existing validation manager and path policy
initial.plan_summary: Recognize the exact Runtime v3/CSM family, execute each crate's focused tests independently, compose coverage, and preserve the existing fallback.

steps.action: Add the bounded mixed-crate classifier and execution plan
Align focused coverage routing and summary composition
Run contract tests, review, publish, and merge

risks: An overly broad classifier could suppress required full validation
A single-crate runner could silently omit half of the change
Coverage summary composition could report only one crate
invariants: Every accepted path belongs to the declared Runtime v3 or CSM family
Both crates run when both crates change
All other mixed-crate shapes retain existing fail-closed behavior
No Runtime v2 source is modified
stop_conditions: The route requires modifying Runtime v2
The accepted family cannot be expressed as a closed path set
review_prompts: Can an unrelated mixed-crate change enter the bounded route?
Does each changed crate execute its own tests?
Can coverage omit one crate while still reporting success?
Are Runtime v2 tests excluded by construction?

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove narrow route selection and fail-closed fallback
Prove independent test and coverage execution

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed if the bounded path family is incomplete, either crate is omitted, Runtime v2 is selected, or unrelated mixed-crate shapes become focused.
